- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The app that locals use to navigate public transportation in the greater Lisbon area is called "Carris/Metro."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Carris/Metro app is available for both iOS and Android devices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Carris/Metro app provides real-time information on buses, trams, and metro lines, as well as a map of the network and details on schedules, fares, and disruptions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Carris/Metro app has an English language option for non-Portuguese speakers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Carris/Metro app has a user-friendly interface with intuitive icons and symbols.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The app provides clear and accurate information on schedules, stops, and prices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User-friendly tools help users make informed decisions about their travel plans.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for getting around Lisbon include using public transportation, buying a Lisboa Card, walking around, taking a tuk-tuk tour, taking tram 28, and considering a day trip.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Lisboa Card provides unlimited access to public transportation, discounts on popular attractions, and free admission to many museums and monuments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pena Palace is one of the most popular attractions in Sintra, known for its colorful architecture and beautiful gardens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Castle of the Moors dates back to the 8th century and offers beautiful views of Sintra and the surrounding countryside.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Quinta da Regaleira features a palace, chapel, gardens, and underground tunnels, known for its beautiful architecture and mystical symbolism.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Monserrate Palace is known for its eclectic architecture and beautiful gardens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sintra National Palace was used by the Portuguese royal family from the 15th to the 19th centuries and is known for its beautiful architecture and collections of art and furniture.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in visiting Pena Palace and Quinta da Regaleira.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Sintra include Tascantiga, Adega das Caves, Incomum by Luis Santos, Sabores de Sintra, and Nau Palatina.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tascantiga offers traditional Portuguese dishes such as seafood, grilled meats, and soups.
